## Akra-Bazzi Method — 10 Complete Worked Examples

The method solves recurrences of the form:
\(T(n) = \sum a_i T(n/b_i) + f(n)\)

1. Find \(p\) such that \(\sum a_i \cdot b_i^{-p} = 1\)
2. \(T(n) = \Theta\!\left(n^p + n^p \int_1^n \frac{f(x)}{x^{p+1}}\,dx\right)\)

---

### Example 1: \(T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n\)

\(a=2,\; b=2\)
\(2 \cdot 2^{-p} = 2^{1-p} = 1 \implies p = 1\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{x}{x^{2}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{1}{x}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n\ln n\right) = \Theta(n\lg n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 2: \(T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n/\lg n\)

\(a=2,\; b=2 \implies p = 1\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{x/\ln x}{x^{2}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{1}{x\ln x}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n\,\bigl[\ln(\ln x)\bigr]_1^n\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n\ln\ln n\right) = \Theta(n\lg\lg n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 3: \(T(n) = T(n/2) + T(n/3) + n\)

\(a_1=1,\;b_1=2,\; a_2=1,\;b_2=3\)
\(2^{-p} + 3^{-p} = 1\)
Trial: \(p=0.79 \to 0.577+0.429=1.006\); \(p=0.80 \to 0.574+0.425=0.999\)
\(\implies p \approx 0.798\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n^{p} + n^{p} \int_1^n \frac{x}{x^{p+1}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n^{p} + n^{p} \int_1^n x^{-p}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n^{p} + n^{p}\cdot \frac{n^{1-p}-1}{1-p}\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n^{p} + \frac{n - n^{p}}{1-p}\right) \\
     &= \Theta(n)  \quad (\text{since } p<1,\; n\text{ dominates})
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 4: \(T(n) = 3T(n/3) + n\)

\(a=3,\; b=3\)
\(3 \cdot 3^{-p} = 3^{1-p} = 1 \implies p = 1\)

\[
T(n) = \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{1}{x}\,dx\right) = \Theta(n + n\ln n) = \Theta(n\lg n)
\]

---

### Example 5: \(T(n) = 2T(n/4) + \sqrt{n}\)

\(a=2,\; b=4\)
\(2 \cdot 4^{-p} = 2^{1-2p} = 1 \implies p = \frac12\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(\sqrt{n} + \sqrt{n} \int_1^n \frac{x^{1/2}}{x^{3/2}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(\sqrt{n} + \sqrt{n} \int_1^n \frac{1}{x}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(\sqrt{n} + \sqrt{n}\ln n\right) = \Theta(\sqrt{n}\,\lg n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 6: \(T(n) = T(n/2) + n^2\)

\(a=1,\; b=2\)
\(2^{-p} = 1 \implies p = 0\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(1 + \int_1^n \frac{x^2}{x^{1}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(1 + \int_1^n x\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(1 + \frac{n^2-1}{2}\right) = \Theta(n^2)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 7: \(T(n) = 4T(n/2) + n^2\)

\(a=4,\; b=2\)
\(4 \cdot 2^{-p} = 2^{2-p} = 1 \implies p = 2\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n^2 + n^2 \int_1^n \frac{x^2}{x^{3}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n^2 + n^2 \int_1^n \frac{1}{x}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n^2 + n^2 \ln n\right) = \Theta(n^2\lg n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 8: \(T(n) = T(2n/3) + 1\)

\(a=1,\; b = \frac32\) (since \(n/b = 2n/3\))
\((\frac32)^{-p} = (\frac23)^p = 1 \implies p = 0\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(1 + \int_1^n \frac{1}{x^{1}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(1 + \ln n\right) = \Theta(\lg n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 9: \(T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n\lg n\)

\(a=2,\; b=2 \implies p = 1\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{x\lg x}{x^{2}}\,dx\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{\lg x}{x}\,dx\right) \\
\lg x = \frac{\ln x}{\ln 2},\quad
\int\frac{\ln x}{x}\,dx &= \frac{(\ln x)^2}{2} \\
\implies T(n) &= \Theta\!\left(n + n\cdot\frac{(\ln n)^2}{2\ln 2}\right) \\
     &= \Theta\!\left(n + \frac{\ln 2}{2}\,n\,(\lg n)^2\right) \\
     &= \Theta(n\,\lg^2 n)
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### Example 10: \(T(n) = T(n/4) + T(3n/4) + n\)

\(a_1=1,\;b_1=4,\; a_2=1,\;b_2=\frac43\) (since \(n/b_2 = 3n/4\))
\((\frac14)^p + (\frac34)^p = 1\)
Try \(p=1\): \(\frac14 + \frac34 = 1 \;\checkmark\)

\[
T(n) = \Theta\!\left(n + n \int_1^n \frac{1}{x}\,dx\right) = \Theta(n + n\ln n) = \Theta(n\lg n)
\]

---

**Summary Table:**

| # | Recurrence | \(p\) | Result |
|---|-----------|-------|--------|
| 1 | \(2T(n/2)+n\) | 1 | \(\Theta(n\lg n)\) |
| 2 | \(2T(n/2)+n/\lg n\) | 1 | \(\Theta(n\lg\lg n)\) |
| 3 | \(T(n/2)+T(n/3)+n\) | ≈0.798 | \(\Theta(n)\) |
| 4 | \(3T(n/3)+n\) | 1 | \(\Theta(n\lg n)\) |
| 5 | \(2T(n/4)+\sqrt{n}\) | 1/2 | \(\Theta(\sqrt{n}\lg n)\) |
| 6 | \(T(n/2)+n^2\) | 0 | \(\Theta(n^2)\) |
| 7 | \(4T(n/2)+n^2\) | 2 | \(\Theta(n^2\lg n)\) |
| 8 | \(T(2n/3)+1\) | 0 | \(\Theta(\lg n)\) |
| 9 | \(2T(n/2)+n\lg n\) | 1 | \(\Theta(n\lg^2 n)\) |
| 10 | \(T(n/4)+T(3n/4)+n\) | 1 | \(\Theta(n\lg n)\) |
